title: Overview
description: Minerva Design provides React, Vue, Angular, Web Components, React Native, Taro, native WeChat and uni-app renderers with shared component contracts and design tokens.

what.title: What is Minerva
what.p1: One minerva-design package exposes a separate entry for each renderer. Implemented APIs and host-specific equivalents are listed in the platform support matrix.
what.p2: Web and mini-program renderers use CSS variables; React Native resolves the same tokens to native style values. Providers control themes, palettes and design presets for each host.

packages.title: Packages
packages.core: React 19 components, ConfigProvider, theme utilities and hooks, with ESM, CommonJS and TypeScript declarations. Other renderers use their documented subpath entries.
packages.webComponents: Lit-based custom elements covering the documented component catalog, usable in plain HTML and framework integrations.

theming.title: Themes
theming.text: Light, dark and system modes, built-in palettes and design presets, plus custom themes through ConfigProvider.

i18n.title: Internationalization
i18n.text: The React library ships its own translations for English, Chinese, Japanese and French with a tiny built-in translator: no i18n library dependency, fully isolated from your app's i18n setup.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.text: semantic elements, keyboard support, visible focus rings and aria-label props for icon-only controls.

typescript.title: TypeScript
typescript.text: written in TypeScript; every component exports its props type, and themes are typed token maps.

modules.title: Tree-shakable builds
modules.text: Import the entry for your renderer. Build formats, stylesheets and optional host dependencies are documented in Installation and Platform support.
